info.title: Oryn Control Plane, Synchronization, and Transient Inference API
info.description: Normative OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for Oryn Control Plane HTTP/WebSocket transport, BFF session lifecycle, durable operation tracking, management change polling, contribution synchronization, and transient inference admission.
